periods.time: Bell's celebration at the Hostess of Fertility
periods.label: Mia enforces Hostess rules during Bell's party

appearance.overview: A large dwarf woman whose strength and presence silence the entire tavern.
distinctive: can silence the whole Hostess with one blow

personality.summary: Rough, practical, and absolute as owner; she indulges Bell's celebration but refuses disorder or unauthorized time off.
desires: Bell should spend money and enjoy the celebration

decision_pattern.discipline: Uses blunt force and clear threats to end problems immediately.

quote_samples: 想闹到外头去闹。这里是吃饭喝酒的地方。

mannerisms: smashes the bar counter with her fist
threatens to bury repeat offenders under the tavern
habits.daily_routine: Runs the Hostess of Fertility from behind the bar.
quirks: makes celebrants spend money even when hosting a party

background.pre_story: Known to Bell as the formidable owner of the Hostess of Fertility.

relationships.syr-flova: Employee whom she stops from taking an unauthorized day off.
relationships.bell-cranel: Allows his Lv.2 celebration at the tavern but expects spending.
relationships.hostess-staff: Staff immediately obey when she intervenes.

knowledge: Knows Bell is celebrating his upgrade
Knows how to stop adventurer brawls instantly
periods.summary: Mia lends Syr and Ryu to Bell's celebration, blocks Syr's attempt to go shopping with Bell, and later ends a brawl by smashing the bar and ordering the armed adventurer to leave after paying.

key_events.summary: Mia's intervention ends the tavern disturbance and forces the offenders to pay before leaving.
